persona_summary: Yasmine (38) recently moved to Etterbeek with her daughter Lina (9). After her divorce she is living on one income for the first time.
diary_opener: Hey Yasmine, I've already lived your next month, and I'll go through it calmly with you. The big one: on one income it almost added up, and the extra costs right now were one-offs.

cards.title: My first month on one income almost added up
cards.body: Rent, school and daily costs now ran on my salary alone. I was about €70 short, mostly because of one-off costs.

signals.label: Joint account closed
signals.detail: On 9 September your joint account was closed, and your share of €1,820 went to your own account

signals.label: Rent at your new address
signals.detail: You paid your first rent of €1,180 in Etterbeek and set up energy at the same address

signals.label: One-off legal fees
signals.detail: You paid €1,450 to a law firm, the second invoice since July. I count that as a one-off

signals.label: You're keeping an eye on your balance
signals.detail: You checked your balance more often than usual this week. A calm overview can make that easier

actions.title: A calm conversation, with a person
actions.body: Half an hour with a KBC adviser, by phone or in the branch. You choose what it's about. Nothing to sign.

actions.title: A fresh start for your budget
actions.body: An overview with only your income and costs. One-off costs like the lawyer are shown separately.

cards.title: Three weeks in, my insurance still reflected my old situation
cards.body: My life insurance still named my ex-partner as beneficiary, and my home was still on the old address. I could change that whenever I was ready.

signals.label: Old beneficiary
signals.detail: Your KBC Life policy from 2017 still names your ex-partner as beneficiary

signals.label: New address
signals.detail: You changed your address to Etterbeek in the app, with Lina registered with you

actions.title: Checklist: what to update after a divorce
actions.body: A short list: the beneficiary of your life insurance, the address on your policies and who can see your accounts.

actions.title: Tenant insurance for your new home
actions.body: As a tenant you are liable for fire and water damage. KBC Home Insurance covers your apartment and belongings in Etterbeek.

cards.title: The month after, I found a new rhythm as a single mum
cards.body: Maintenance, Groeipakket and school costs slowly found a fixed place in my month. With a clear overview I could plan ahead calmly.

signals.label: Question to Kate
signals.detail: You asked Kate: "How do I see if maintenance came in?"

cards.title: Six months in, I got about €600 back through my taxes
cards.body: As a single parent with Lina living with me, I got a higher tax-free allowance. That counted in the following year's tax return.

actions.body: A simple explanation of the single-parent supplement and what to check in your next tax return with the tax office (FOD Financiën).
